title: AION 2 Gear Progression: Level 45 Upgrade Route
description: An ordered route through exploration, starter upgrades, Draupnir, belt morphing and later equipment.
summary: An ordered route through exploration, starter upgrades, Draupnir, belt morphing and later equipment.
quickAnswer: At 45, collect exploration rewards and spend Daevanion points, enhance your Spirit Forged weapon and Guard, morph the +10 green belt, then fill weak slots through Draupnir. Work toward 1,400 for Vakron Sky Island Conquest.
